width.en: The bridge has enough width for two bicycles to pass safely.
width.zh: 這座橋的寬度足以讓兩輛腳踏車安全通過。

wig.en: The actor wore a silver wig during the stage performance.
wig.zh: 那位演員在舞台演出時戴著銀色假髮。

wilderness.en: The documentary explores wildlife living deep in the mountain wilderness.
wilderness.zh: 紀錄片探索生活在深山荒野中的野生動物。

wildlife.en: The park protects wildlife by limiting access to certain areas.
wildlife.zh: 公園透過限制部分區域進入來保護野生動物。

willing.en: Several students were willing to volunteer for the weekend event.
willing.zh: 有幾位學生願意為週末活動擔任志工。

windshield.en: Rain covered the windshield during the drive through the hills.
windshield.zh: 開車穿越山區時，雨水覆滿了擋風玻璃。

windy.en: It was too windy to hold the outdoor poster display.
windy.zh: 風太大，不適合舉辦戶外海報展示。

wing.en: The bird stretched one wing before flying from the branch.
wing.zh: 那隻鳥在飛離樹枝前伸展了一側翅膀。

wink.en: She gave a quick wink after solving the puzzle correctly.
wink.zh: 她解對謎題後快速眨了一下眼。

wipe.en: Please wipe the table after finishing the science activity.
wipe.zh: 自然科學活動結束後，請把桌面擦乾淨。

wire.en: A thin wire connected the sensor to the measuring device.
wire.zh: 一條細電線把感測器連接到測量裝置。

wisdom.en: The story suggests that wisdom often grows through experience.
wisdom.zh: 這個故事暗示智慧往往會隨經驗累積而成長。

wit.en: Her quick wit made the classroom discussion lively and memorable.
wit.zh: 她的機智讓課堂討論既活潑又令人印象深刻。

witch.en: A friendly witch appears in the children's fantasy story.
witch.zh: 一位友善的女巫出現在這本兒童奇幻故事中。

wither.en: Leaves may wither quickly when plants receive too little water.
wither.zh: 植物水分不足時，葉片可能很快枯萎。

withhold.en: The editor decided to withhold the article until facts were verified.
withhold.zh: 編輯決定等事實查證後再刊出文章。

workout.en: The team planned a light workout before the afternoon practice.
workout.zh: 球隊在下午訓練前安排了一次輕度運動。

workshop.en: The school hosted a writing workshop for interested students.
workshop.zh: 學校為有興趣的學生舉辦寫作工作坊。

worm.en: An earthworm is a type of worm commonly found in soil.
worm.zh: 蚯蚓是一種常見於土壤中的蠕蟲。

worse.en: The traffic became worse after heavy rain began downtown.
worse.zh: 市中心開始下大雨後，交通變得更糟。

worship.en: The course examines how communities worship in different cultural traditions.
worship.zh: 課程探討不同文化傳統中的社群如何進行崇拜。

worst.en: The worst delay occurred during the morning rush hour.
worst.zh: 最嚴重的延誤發生在早晨尖峰時段。

worthwhile.en: The project was difficult but ultimately worthwhile for the whole class.
worthwhile.zh: 這個專題雖然困難，但對全班而言最後仍很值得。

worthy.en: The judges considered every final project worthy of careful review.
worthy.zh: 評審認為每個決賽作品都值得仔細審查。

diffusion.en: The experiment demonstrates diffusion as particles spread through the liquid.
diffusion.zh: 這項實驗展示粒子在液體中擴散的現象。

dignify.en: Careful language can dignify a serious discussion rather than weaken it.
dignify.zh: 審慎的措辭能讓嚴肅討論更莊重，而不是削弱它。

dignitary.en: A visiting dignitary attended the opening ceremony at the museum.
dignitary.zh: 一位來訪的重要人士出席了博物館開幕典禮。

dilute.en: Adding more water can dilute the color of the solution.
dilute.zh: 加入更多水可以稀釋溶液的顏色。

disapproval.en: Her quiet disapproval was clear from the tone of her reply.
disapproval.zh: 從她回覆的語氣可以清楚感受到她的不贊同。

disbelieve.en: It is easy to disbelieve a claim that lacks evidence.
disbelieve.zh: 對缺乏證據的主張產生懷疑是很自然的。

disco.en: The school musical included a short disco scene from the 1970s.
disco.zh: 學校音樂劇中加入了一小段七○年代的迪斯可場景。

discontent.en: Growing discontent led the committee to review the policy again.
discontent.zh: 日益增加的不滿促使委員會重新檢討政策。

discouraging.en: The first results were discouraging, but the group kept improving.
discouraging.zh: 最初的結果令人洩氣，但小組仍持續改進。

discrepancy.en: A discrepancy appeared between the two sets of survey data.
discrepancy.zh: 兩組調查資料之間出現了差異。

discretion.en: Teachers may use discretion when handling unusual classroom situations.
discretion.zh: 老師處理特殊課堂情況時可以自行斟酌。

disgusting.en: The spoiled food had a disgusting smell and was thrown away.
disgusting.zh: 腐敗食物散發難聞氣味，因此被丟棄。

dishwasher.en: The cafeteria installed a new dishwasher to speed up cleanup.
dishwasher.zh: 餐廳裝了一台新的洗碗機，加快清潔工作。

disinterested.en: A disinterested observer can sometimes evaluate a dispute more fairly.
disinterested.zh: 沒有利害關係的觀察者有時能更公平評估爭議。

dismantle.en: Workers will dismantle the old stage after the festival ends.
dismantle.zh: 活動結束後，工作人員會拆除舊舞台。

disorganized.en: The notes looked disorganized until she sorted them by topic.
disorganized.zh: 她依主題整理前，筆記看起來很雜亂。

dispel.en: Clear evidence can dispel rumors before they spread further.
dispel.zh: 清楚的證據可以在謠言進一步散播前加以澄清。

displacement.en: The report examines population displacement after a major natural disaster.
displacement.zh: 報告探討重大天然災害後的人口遷移問題。

displease.en: The sudden schedule change may displease some participants.
displease.zh: 突然更改時程可能讓部分參與者不滿。

disposition.en: Her calm disposition helped the group handle pressure during the presentation.
disposition.zh: 她沉著的性情幫助小組在簡報時應對壓力。

disqualify.en: Breaking the competition rules may disqualify a team from the event.
disqualify.zh: 違反競賽規則可能使隊伍失去參賽資格。

disregard.en: Students should not disregard safety signs in the laboratory.
disregard.zh: 學生不應忽視實驗室裡的安全標示。

dissatisfaction.en: Customer dissatisfaction increased after repeated delays in delivery.
dissatisfaction.zh: 一再延遲送貨後，顧客的不滿增加了。

dissatisfy.en: Incomplete information may dissatisfy readers seeking a clear answer.
dissatisfy.zh: 資訊不完整可能讓想得到明確答案的讀者不滿。

dissident.en: The history article describes a dissident who criticized the government peacefully.
dissident.zh: 歷史文章描述一位以和平方式批評政府的異議人士。

dissuade.en: The counselor tried to dissuade students from skipping important practice sessions.
dissuade.zh: 輔導老師試著勸學生不要缺席重要的練習時段。
